name: CheckboxListTile
description: A widget that combines a checkbox with a ListTile, allowing for a labeled checkbox with optional subtitle and secondary widget. Useful for forms, settings, and options lists.

properties.name: title
properties.description: The primary content of the list tile, usually a Text widget.

properties.name: subtitle
properties.description: Additional content displayed below the title.

properties.name: value
properties.possible_values: true, false, or null (if tristate is true)

properties.name: onChanged
properties.description: Called when the user taps the checkbox to change its state.

properties.name: secondary
properties.description: A widget to display opposite the checkbox, often an icon or avatar.

properties.name: activeColor
properties.description: The color to use when the checkbox is checked.

properties.name: checkColor
properties.description: The color of the check icon inside the checkbox.

properties.name: tristate
properties.description: Whether the checkbox can have three states: true, false, or null.

properties.name: controlAffinity
properties.description: The position of the checkbox relative to the text.

properties.name: dense
properties.description: Whether this list tile is part of a vertically dense list.
